premises.text: Electrical lighting drives large CO2, electricity use, and light-pollution harms that nature-inspired bioluminescence can address
premises.evidence_span: Electrical lighting is responsible for 1.7 billion tons of CO2 emissions, is 15% of global electricity consumption, and more than 80% of humans are affected by light pollution

premises.text: Glowee grows living bioluminescent material as a liquid patented biological lighting solution that can fill any casing shape
premises.evidence_span: created a growing and living raw material, bioluminescence material

premises.text: Glow Events provides ephemeral lighting up to about one week and Pipelight provides continuous maintained glowing without lifespan limits
premises.evidence_span: Glow Events, and it's an ephemeral light to light temporal spaces, and it can light up to one week

premises.text: Genes for squid bioluminescence are inserted into engineered lab-grown bacteria that are grown with nutrients in transparent shells
premises.evidence_span: synthesize some genes coding for bioluminescent inside squids. Then we insert into lab-grown bacteria

premises.text: Go-to-market licenses technology to energy-provider partners who operate installations, analogous to solar scaling
premises.evidence_span: partnering with energy providers. So we license to them our technology, and they operate the system

premises.text: Events educate and create visibility while Pipelight bioreactors are fed with industrial waste to close a circular loop toward outdoor and hospitality uses
premises.evidence_span: feed our microbes with waste coming from different kinds of industries

domains.name: energy-provider licensing and circular waste feed

value.text: Reduce environmental impact and improve wellness with natural bioluminescent light that enables new design
value.evidence_span: reduce the environmental impact, to improve wellness thanks to the quality of this natural light, and to offer a lot of new design possibilities

secondary_value.text: Design more livable and sustainable cities by replacing electric landscape lighting
secondary_value.evidence_span: design more livable and sustainable cities for tomorrow

notes: CO2/electricity/pollution folded as one electric-lighting problem set. Glow Events and Pipelight kept as two product modes within bioluminescent offering; bacteria engineering folded into product domain. Unit sales and press features excluded as traction. Health wavelength benefits folded into value/secondary rather than extra premises.
